description: MSc student at the University of Trento, focusing on model optimization (fine-tuning, LoRA/QLoRA, distillation, quantization), multi-agent coordination, and integrating AI models into software systems. Lead systems architect on the ASA Autobots multi-agent capstone project.
Tutoring undergraduate students in Rust, Advanced Programming, and Compilers since the 2024/25 academic year, beginning in the third year of my BSc in Computer Science.
Completed a Bachelor's degree in Computer Science. Thesis: Kindle, a machine-learning framework for compile-time invariant and dimensionality safety.
